row1.heading: If You Want To Relieve Sciatica And Back Pain... You Must Fix Your Dried-Out Discs

Stretches don't rehydrate discs. Pills don't rehydrate discs. Even surgery doesn't rehydrate discs.
Until you restore your disc fluid, you're just masking symptoms.
Swedish researchers proved 91% of chronic sciatica is dehydrated discs. Fix the discs = fix the pain.
